title: Open a small online shop from one sentence
summary: @i_am_dflame says one sentence to their agent, Awning, put a coffee shop online on its own domain, and a separate chat then booked a paid $5 tasting.
agent_role: The agent created and published the shop from a one-line description after one human payment approval. A separate agent chat later found the shop and booked and paid for a tasting.
outcome: Author reports the shop went live on its own domain and received a $5 booking paid straight to the owner's wallet.
what_they_did: The poster gave their agent one sentence: "Ridge Roast, coffee from Accra." They approved one payment step through PayBox. The agent then put the shop live on its own web address. To test it, a fresh chat with an agent searched for the shop and booked a tasting.
how_it_went: The author says the shop went live and a $5 tasting was booked. They say the payment went straight to the owner's wallet. A video demo accompanies the post.
worth_knowing: This is a launch post for the poster's own tool, Awning, so the demo comes from its maker and gives few details on setup.
prompt: Help me set up a simple online shop for [business name], which sells [what you sell] in [your city]. Draft a short description, a product or booking list with prices, and a plan for a web page and payment setup. Show me the full draft and the costs before you register a domain, connect payments or publish anything, and wait for my approval at each step.

curation.rationale: A short demo shows an agent setting up a live storefront from one sentence, and a second agent booking and paying for a $5 tasting. It reads largely as a product introduction with few details, so it is thin.
